segments.description: Opening clip showing pasta dough being fed into a pasta maker machine with Jamie Oliver text logo.
Jamie Oliver introduces himself and his son Buddy as they prepare to make homemade pasta.
Close-up shot of flour being poured onto a wooden board.
Jamie talks about the ingredients needed to make egg pasta.
Close-up of Jamie's hand making a well in the flour.
Jamie asks Buddy about the quantities of egg and flour and cracks an egg into the flour well.
Close-up shot mixing egg and flour together with a fork.
Jamie explains how to bring the pasta dough together.
Close-up of Buddy kneading the dough with his hands.
Jamie talks about the texture of the dough while watching Buddy knead.
Close-up shot of Buddy's hands pressing and rolling the dough.
Jamie comments on Buddy's kneading technique.
Close-up of Buddy shaping the dough ball.
Jamie shows pre-made rested dough and explains how to roll it out into sheets.
Close-up shot of thin sheet of pasta dough over Jamie's hand.
Jamie and Buddy begin feeding pasta sheet through the roller.
Close-up of pasta sheet passing through machine rollers.
Jamie and Buddy demonstrate how the pasta sheet gets longer and thinner.
Close-up of Buddy listening and holding the end of the long pasta sheet.
Jamie asks Buddy what he loves most about making pasta.
Buddy explains why he likes making pasta shapes.
Jamie discusses different uses for pasta sheets like lasagna and cannelloni.
Close-up reaction shot of Buddy.
Jamie cuts pasta sheets into smaller sections.
Close-up of hands cutting pasta sheet with a knife.
Jamie hands pasta strips to Buddy for cutting into strands.
Close-up of pasta sheet feeding into cutter attachment.
Jamie describes taglierini pasta coming out of cutter.
Close-up of thin pasta strands emerging from the cutter machine.
Jamie names the cut pasta types.
Close-up of Buddy smiling happily.
Jamie inspects the freshly cut pasta nest.
Close-up shot of a delicate nest of fine taglierini pasta.
Jamie prepares to cut wider tagliatelle pasta.
Close-up of wider pasta sheet passing through tagliatelle cutter.
Jamie arranges the different cut pasta shapes on table.
Close-up shot showing nests of tagliatelle and taglierini side by side.
Jamie demonstrates cutting lasagna sheets.
Close-up shot of folded pasta sheet for lasagna.
Jamie demonstrates rolling pasta for cannelloni.
Close-up of hands rolling pasta dough cylinder.
Jamie shows how to use a fluted pastry wheel.
Close-up of fluted pastry cutter cutting pasta rectangle edges.
Jamie shows how to pinch pasta rectangle center to form farfalle bows.
Close-up of Buddy showing farfalle pasta bow on his palm.
Close-up of finished farfalle pasta bow sitting on hand.
Jamie wraps up the demonstration in the kitchen.
Close-up shot of Buddy smiling near the pasta maker.
Jamie gives encouraging closing remarks with Buddy.
Outro title card overlay over pasta machine shot.

hook.opening_visual: Pasta sheet feeding through a pasta machine with title text overlay
hook.opening_line: So me and my best mate here, Buddy, we're making some pasta.
hook.notes: Introduces chef Jamie Oliver and his son making pasta together in studio kitchen.
